description:
Generate booking deep-links for an ONGOING MENTORSHIP (subscription / PricingPlan). Returns:
  - apply_url: where the user starts the subscription. Optional     plan_hash pre-selects a specific plan.
  - inquiry_url: free question before committing (no booking).
  - requires_intro_call: when true, the mentor offers an intro     call (free or paid – see intro_call_note). apply_url already     routes the user to the scheduler first — mention the intro     call when sharing it.

IMPORTANT: this tool is for ongoing mentorships only. For ONE-OFF SESSIONS, use the `booking_url` from get_sessions_or_services directly — those bookings go through /sessions/<slug>/book/, NOT /apply/.

The user must click the link and sign in via the browser — this tool does NOT book on their behalf.
name: create_booking_link

outputSchema.description: Return shape of create_booking_link (ongoing mentorship only).

apply_url.description: Where the user starts the subscription. The user must click and sign in; this tool does not book on their behalf.
apply_url.title: Apply Url

error.description: Error code: 'not_found' or 'rate_limit_exceeded'. Absent on success.
error.title: Error

intro_call_note.description: Guidance about the intro call (free or paid); present only when requires_intro_call is true.
intro_call_note.title: Intro Call Note

next_step.description: What to do with the links.
next_step.title: Next Step

requires_intro_call.description: When true, apply_url routes to the scheduler first; mention the intro call (see intro_call_note for free vs paid).
requires_intro_call.title: Requires Intro Call

username.description: Echoes the requested username on a not_found error.
username.title: Username

outputSchema.title: BookingLinkResponse
